name: two-hop-additive-gain-discriminator
purpose: One predeclared matched current-waveform +3 dB-Hz E capture tests a bounded additive persistent-plus-OU gain family after the pure 8/32-second alternatives failed to recover slot 12. Each new model has an unknown static proper-complex Gaussian component with variance 0.5 and an independent OU component with variance 0.5, using the existing 0.5/2-second scales. A fixed 0.75 share retains the original affine family and each additive alternative receives 0.125. Eligibility is public fast-cadence DATA of at least 32 seconds with one spatial basis; original VLF models, public hypotheses, thresholds and worker/resource bounds remain. Exact normalized dense-covariance parity, repeated high-Gram observations including zero and tiny elapsed intervals, and additive-only separation in a simultaneous stable/changing synthetic check must pass before execution. Match the baseline full noisy IQ, qualified table, source/noise seeds, profile and all 15 public windows. The repair criterion is 13/13 correct DATA including improved correct-bit affine/operational evidence at slot 12, with both genuine ending quiet slots preserved and correct E completion. Report model kind, work, workspace, source identity and field preparation separately. A score gain without recovery is an informative partial result, not repair or automatic permission to tune. Stop after this row; no automatic variance, scale, seed or model-bank sweep. If repaired, separately freeze the original weak/raw-polarity matrix and changing-rate/negative preservation checks before production acceptance. This selected mechanism test is not a holdout or field-outage probability estimate. The 900-second bound includes physical table construction; no private path strength, frequency or state reaches the receiver.
